items.title: Solana's Jupiter Expands Beyond Trading With Token Baskets, Yield Vaults and New Portfolio
items.summary: The trading platform, which says it has routed more than $1.3 trillion in trades, is launching four products ahead of Solana Breakpoint.

items.title: Decrypt Money Account Gets Confidential Transfers With Solana Privacy Firm Helius
items.summary: Helius' Solana Privacy Rings will let Decrypt users send funds without broadcasting amounts, as it grows out The Information Exchange.

items.title: Introducing Solana Privacy Rings
items.summary: Solana Privacy Rings enable programmable, fully onchain privacy solutions on Solana. Learn how it works and how to get started.

items.title: Solana Set for Another Tokenized Stock Venue as Formation Notifies the SEC
items.summary: Operating under the SEC’s “Innovation Exemption,” the firm plans to list tokenized shares of Exodus, Forward Industries, and Galaxy Digital in early 2027, with the same voting and dividend rights as real stock.

items.title: Introducing the Parsed Events Scan API
items.summary: Scan any wallet on Solana using server-side filters for programs, instructions, token mint addresses, and only pay for what you scan.

items.title: Agave 4.4 Update: All You Need to Know
items.summary: A roundup of the most important features and performance upgrades in the Solana Agave 4.4 validator client release.

items.title: The Price of Cheap Writes: How does RocksDB read?
items.summary: RocksDB reads newest to oldest, stopping at the first version it finds. Learn how bloom filters, the block cache, and prefix seeks keep that search fast.
